title: Stop retrying a confirmed-orphan persona provisioning reconciliation forever
summary_zh: _reconcile_persona_provisioning_once() 每 5 秒重讀 BFF 本地三個來源（read_store/provisioning store/_PERSONA_BFF_OVERLAY）合併出的 provisioning/provisioning_failed persona 清單，並試著把終態寫回權威 persona registry。若 registry 回報查無此人（PersonaReconciliationMutationError），先前的程式碼只記一次 warning 就繼續，下一輪還會再試同一筆——永遠失敗、永遠重試。這次修改把這個特定例外類型獨立出來：命中後把該 persona_id 記進一個 process 內的 skip set，之後的每一輪都直接跳過它，直到程序重啟為止。其他型態的例外（例如暫時性網路錯誤）維持原樣、每輪照常重試。

owned: In-process orphan-skip tracking for confirmed-not-found persona provisioning reconciliation records
not_changing: The three BFF-local read sources merged by _list_persona_records (read_store, persona provisioning store, _PERSONA_BFF_OVERLAY) -- no schema or storage change, no new delete/removal capability added to PersonaProvisioningStore
The persona_write_owner / PersonaRegistryHttpWritePort HTTP contract with the authoritative persona registry service
Reconciliation behavior for any exception other than PersonaReconciliationMutationError -- transient failures still retry every pass
known_gap: This bounds the noise to once per BFF process lifetime, not once ever -- a process restart resumes the warning for the same orphan until whatever created the stale local projection is separately cleaned up (e.g. by deleting the underlying provisioning-store row, out of scope here since PersonaProvisioningStore currently exposes no delete/removal method in either backend implementation).

root_cause.summary: _list_persona_records() merges read_store.list_personas(), the durable persona provisioning store, and the in-memory-only _PERSONA_BFF_OVERLAY dict. A persona id can appear as provisioning/provisioning_failed in one of these BFF-local sources while the authoritative persona registry (a separate microservice, reached via persona_write_owner's HTTP write port) has no record of it at all -- e.g. it was deleted directly from the registry without the local projection being cleared. Every 5-second reconciliation pass (PANTHEON_PERSONA_PROVISIONING_RECONCILE_SECONDS) re-discovers the same stale local record, calls update_persona, gets None back, and PersonaReconciliationMutationError is raised and logged as a warning -- forever, since nothing previously purged or skipped it.
root_cause.observed: persona-c6551ff0570b55679167 logged this warning repeatedly (every ~5s) in the live pantheon-operator-bff-1 container this session.
